description: This file declares utility functions related to network device properties, interface status, security modes, and persistent configurations for NetworkManager within the WPEFramework plugin. It contains class and method declarations with constants for marker file paths and hostname management.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve device properties, interface status, security modes, and manage persistent configurations related to network interfaces.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the network device; implementation details unspecified.

methods.name: wlanIface
methods.description: Returns the name of the WLAN interface as a string.

methods.name: ethIface
methods.description: Returns the name of the Ethernet interface as a string.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts a percentage value into a signal strength metric.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison between two strings.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines the Wi-Fi security mode from access point parameters and flags.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Calculates the Wi-Fi frequency from access point information.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the security mode based on various flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets the NetworkManager log level to trace for detailed logging.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file based on the filename parameter and optional unmark flag.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: readPersistentHostname
methods.description: Reads the persistent hostname into the provided string.
